scope: Exact score-separation diagnostics on the already-consumed frozen v30 Mac regression. No model inference, threshold selection or acceptance.
method: Verify complete source/result identities and all saved UINT8 output hashes; preserve every source and its original order.
Use exact integer sums of each five-score window, denominator 1280, restricted to returning block ends after the application prime. Also retain actual original float64-convolution maxima.
Check that the common prime cannot trigger at any positive threshold and that score-existence at the frozen threshold reproduces each retained source event boolean.

For zero Nyx-confuser false clips, a monotone scalar threshold must strictly exceed the largest confuser score. Count positive maxima strictly above that score as an optimistic upper bound; keep ties explicit. Repeat for the original host arithmetic.
Count positive sources with any nonzero score. If fewer than the descriptive Hi ESP reference hits, no positive threshold can reach that reference even before false clips are considered.
Retain worst-confuser witnesses and per-voice score distributions; do not propose a new threshold, relabel, crop or discard any waveform.
Compare location-free ASTs of features() and Detector in the pinned Mac and GPU commits. Code equivalence does not establish native-library/platform equivalence.
limits: Necessary score-separation bounds for these reused synthesis-intent labels, not population recall/FAR or proof of a pronunciation or training defect.
The Hi ESP 48/50 is a descriptive retained baseline; it is not a newly selected acceptance gate or a matched-FAR population statement.
Original source/prime padding and detector return geometry remain unchanged. No new inference, audio, board, firmware or reserved-data operation.
